research_integration.google_lens: optional external handoff only; not required for HAWKEYE capture/OCR/search
research_integration.gemini_standard: PC-owned credential; selected non-sensitive keyframes only after owner enables cloud mode
research_integration.gemini_live: direct device WebSocket using one-use short-lived token minted by KRISHNA PC
research_integration.local_first: ML Kit object tracking + target-only OCR/barcode + MediaPipe hand landmarks run the deterministic Active Vision fast path; subject segmentation/pose/face-presence/language ID/translation remain available without Gemini after required local model downloads
research_integration.translation: ML Kit on-device translation; dynamic language models download on Wi-Fi and no Gemini API key is required
research_integration.gestures: MediaPipe Gesture Recognizer runs on-device with bundled hand/gesture model; 21 hand landmarks also feed continuous finger-ray target selection independently of opt-in canned gesture commands; pose-based hand raise remains a fallback
research_integration.spatial: Phone IMU/orientation metadata is attached to curated keyframes for BHOOMIPUTRA/photogrammetry correlation; it is not treated as SLAM, depth, or survey-grade pose by itself
research_integration.learning_verification: Distilled HAWKEYE candidates can run through Rishi Live -> Garuda -> Gautama -> Gyan proposal gate without raw-media transfer; automatic model escalation remains local-only
research_integration.openrouter: Mobile may call OpenRouter directly using an owner-provisioned Android-Keystore-encrypted credential. Every automatic request requires a live zero-price model catalog preflight. Paid fallback is forbidden. PC-brokered OpenRouter remains a fallback for cases where the direct route is unavailable.
research_integration.free_cloud_reviews: Sanitized HAWKEYE text summaries may be reviewed by verified Cloudflare Workers AI and configured free_only text gateways such as Groq/Mistral; raw camera frames are not sent to text-only providers.
research_integration.mobile_qwen: disabled on both mobile and KRISHNA routing; installed PC Qwen files may remain but are not selected
research_integration.pc_offload: Private/protected/project actions and heavy HAWKEYE inference stay on KRISHNA PC. Ordinary non-sensitive chat and selected non-sensitive keyframes use mobile direct verified-zero-price cloud first.
research_integration.pc_finding_sync: Mobile direct cloud findings remain on-device for live use and are checkpointed to the PC only on explicit/periodic sync, avoiding a PC round-trip for every frame.
research_integration.pc_compute_relief: When a cloud finding is already recorded, curated evidence sync stores the bounded evidence but skips duplicate PC vision/BRAHMA intake unless explicit heavy escalation is requested.
research_integration.private_transport: First enrollment uses authenticated LAN discovery; after approval the paired phone learns the current private-overlay Core URL. Raw media sync requires unmetered transport plus fresh same-LAN discovery proof.
research_integration.large_media_sync: Resumable 512 KiB chunks to the E-drive Hawkeye inbox; PC SHA-256 verification and atomic promotion are required before mobile sync state advances.
research_integration.assistant_mode: Android VoiceInteractionService + Assistant role; one-time system consent is required for direct background assistant invocation.
research_integration.photographer: Best-frame selection and natural local edit are performed on-device, then the clean photo is saved through Android MediaStore to Pictures/KRISHNA/Photos.
research_integration.mobile_cloud_route: Phone local ML Kit/MediaPipe -> mobile direct verified-zero-price cloud -> KRISHNA PC only for private/protected/heavy/failure escalation.

model_policy.mobile_cloud_credentials: owner-provisioned OpenRouter token encrypted with Android Keystore; Gemini permanent credential remains PC-only; short-lived device tokens permitted
